title: Muscle Mass Falls To 65 Percent By Age 80
hook: Muscle loss accelerates after seventy, but training reversed the study pattern.
closing: Strength training can protect the independence that age otherwise takes away.
question: What keeps you strong?

segments.say: Muscle mass fell to 65 percent by age 80, leaving far less reserve for everyday strength.
After age 70, muscle loss reached 18 percent per decade, showing the decline suddenly accelerates.
Measured sarcopenia fell to 0 percent after resistance training, showing the study participants were not locked into decline.
